address: Leidsekade 106 / Max Euweplein (Holland Casino Amsterdam), Amsterdam-Centrum: 1991 casino with a white-tiled curved upper storey over a red-steel and timber-pergola canal front, joined to a 1900s brick-and-stone Leidsekade townhouse range
notes: Leidsekade 106 (BAG, 1991) is the Holland Casino block on the Singelgracht at Max Euweplein: a 1990s casino with a curved white-tiled upper storey, a glazed ground and mezzanine floor under a timber pergola on red steel columns, joined at the north to a retained 1900s brick-and-stone Leidsekade townhouse range. 537 3DBAG wall surfaces; four fronts are drawn (w01-314 townhouse entrance, w03-257 and w04-245 canal fronts), everything else stays blank.

walls[0] = panel 426 (NW, 28 m, eaves 20.7): the townhouse range: a grey stone base with barred basement windows, brick above with stone-surround windows, and the arched entrance portal with fluted stone pilasters carrying relief panels (bay 1). Drawn as 5 storeys x 7 bays, stone storey 0, a portal entrance and a cornice. Simplified: the carved pilaster reliefs, the entrance canopy and balcony, the cast lamp standard.

walls[1] = panel 329 (W, 24.5 m, 5.9-12.2 m): the canal-front glazed floors with the red steel columns and yellow-framed shop windows, drawn as glazed ground plus one wide-window storey in a red frame colour. walls[2] = panel 3 and walls[3] = panel 18 (W and NE): the white-tiled upper storey with deep-set windows, one wide-window storey; the panel 3 front carries HOLLAND CASINO lettering on its cornice. Simplified: the curved plan (straight facets in 3DBAG), the timber pergola and its steel posts and rails, the lattice balustrade, the heart-banner window graphics, the flagpoles.
Not drawn: the east and south fronts and the lower casino roofs (no panorama within 35 m).
